newsitem.title: FRANCE: France reports 110,000 tonnes extra wheat bids.
newsitem.headline: France reports 110,000 tonnes extra wheat bids.

text.p: International grain traders bid through France on Monday for 110,000 tonnes of European Union soft wheat at a standing export tax of 0.5 Ecus per tonne, the French cereals office ONIC said.

The bids followed applications for 722,500 tonnes on Friday, and bring to at least 832,500 tonnes the amount of EU soft wheat sought for export across the 15-nation EU since Brussels slapped the fixed daily export tax on soft wheat last Thursday.
Under EU rules the European Commission has three working days to decide whether to use its veto over such bids, which are for fixed-value licences valid until the end of December.
ONIC officials said they expected an EU decision on Friday's larger volume of bids to be announced on Wednesday morning followed on Thursday by the answer on today's 110,000 tonnes.
